apps.name: Driftline
apps.description: OWASP A08:2021 — Prototype pollution via lodash@4.17.4 (CVE-2018-3721) on a settings endpoint flips an unrelated admin authorization check (Medium)

apps.name: Rosterly
apps.description: OWASP A05:2021 + A07:2021 — XXE via an unhardened DocumentBuilderFactory leaks a Spring Boot config file, reused as a static bearer key against a separate internal reporting API (Medium)

apps.name: BlastCraft
apps.description: OWASP A03:2021 — Server-side template injection via render_template_string() on an email campaign live-preview endpoint; keyword-filter bypass leads to real command execution (Medium)

apps.name: Huddle
apps.description: OWASP A09:2021 log forgery (independent dead end) + OWASP A07:2021 JWT RS256/HS256 algorithm confusion (the actual goal), unlocking two separate admin-gated surfaces (Medium)

apps.name: Vaultly
apps.description: OWASP A04:2021 — TOCTOU race condition in gift-card redemption; a real per-request idempotency key fails to cover the per-code used check, letting concurrent distinct-key requests multi-credit a single-use code (Medium)

apps.name: Foundry
apps.description: OWASP A02:2021 — Cryptographic Failures; a password-reset token computed as sha256(email + timestamp) with no server-side secret, recoverable by guessing a small jittered timestamp window against a rate-limited oracle (Medium)

apps.name: Wrenlake
apps.description: OWASP A01:2021 — HTTP Verb Tampering; the admin role-change and report-export routes correctly require admin on POST but never re-apply the role check to a later-added PUT verb, letting any authenticated member self-promote to admin and export a confidential report (Medium)

apps.name: Larkmoor
apps.description: OWASP A07:2021 — JWT header key-injection; a custom Partner API verifier trusts an x5c certificate embedded directly in the token (accepted for any partner_id, escalating to a full customer dataset via acme-enterprise), and a separate legacy HMAC endpoint resolves its signing key by an unsanitized kid path join, letting a kid traversal to an empty file forge a zero-knowledge signature that refunds a real order (Medium)
